params.body:
## Why

Registering on gentells.com asks for no proof of the address. When a team member signs in with the Observatory password, the account that exists on their address becomes their team account. Whoever made that account kept their way in: its password, sessions, keys and linked providers. Since #312 such an account can also keep sources.

## What

- `App\Accounts\WaysIn::end`: the password, a running change of address, reset and invite links, linked providers, sessions, keys and their refresh tokens. It runs at the moment an existing account is linked to a team member, and not at later sign-ins.
- `User::provenTeam` no longer counts a linked provider. Linking one asks for a signed-in session and not for a confirmed address.
- Blocking an account also ends the refresh tokens of its keys. Until now only the keys themselves ended.

A team member who was a reader first notices that the old password stops working and that a linked provider has to be linked again. The Observatory password works.

## Checked

- `TeamLoginTest`: linking ends each of these; signing in again leaves the keys alone. `McpSourceToolsTest`: a linked provider is not proof, a confirmed address is.
- Full suite: the one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which needs a git folder the worktree does not have.

## Limits

- Accounts that were linked before this change keep what they have. On production no team account is waiting to be linked today, so nobody notices the change now.
- A team member who only ever signs in with a provider does not see the team's tools on `/mcp` until they sign in once with the Observatory password.

## After merge

Nothing to run.
params.title: Linking a team account ends every way in from before
